customised.description: True when this scope, or this measure, has limits a person set; false while a default applies.

sample.description: How many things the value is based on (appointments, pathways, slots, beds, invoices).

Reading.description: A measure's value against its tiers.

duplicate.description: True when this receipt had been stored before and nothing changed.

detail.description: A short reason code for a bounce.

letter_id.description: Our letter id, which we gave the carrier as the message's reference.

receipt_id.description: The carrier's id for this report. The idempotency key with the carrier name.

note.description: A short note (at most 200 characters); no more than staff need to make the adjustment.

review_by.description: When a person should look at the adjustment again.

RecurrenceEnd.description:
Termination condition for a recurrence rule. Exactly one of `Count`
or `Until` is present; never both, never neither.

oneOf.description:
Exactly N occurrences (including the first one at
`series.start_datetime`). Must be `>= 1`.

Stop after this datetime (inclusive — occurrences whose start
is `<= until` are kept). Must be `>= series.start_datetime`.

One recurrence rule. Mirrors RFC 5545 fields but in struct form
rather than the iCal string syntax — we never round-trip to the
wire format.

by_weekday.description:
For `Frequency::Weekly` only: restrict to these weekdays. When
empty / `None`, the series fires on the same weekday as
`start_datetime`. Ignored for Daily / Monthly.

interval.description:
Every N units of `frequency`. `1` = every day/week/month.
Must be `>= 1`.

appointment_id.description: The appointment booked from this referral, if any.

redirected_to_service.description: For a redirect: the service it went to and the new referral that carries the patient there.

triaged_by.description: Set when a consultant triaged the referral (`returned_with_advice` or `redirected`).

ReferralStatus.description: Where a referral has got to.

Reinstated.description: The answer to cancelling a discharge.

ReleaseClass.description: How an ended appointment relates to the chance to refill its slot.

median_seconds_to_refill.description: Median seconds from release to refill, over refilled releases. `None` when there are none.

Releases.description: What `GET /api/slot-releases` sends: the counts and the releases they count.

RemovalsByService.description: Removals, reinstatements and keeps for one service in the period. No identifiers.

RemovalsReport.description: The validation removals report: the period and a row per service.

oneOf.description: For `cancel`: the barrier the patient gave, if any.

message_id.description: The channel's own id for the message. The idempotency key.

oneOf.description: For `convert`: `video` or `phone` (CAP-14).

new_slot_id.description: For `rebook`: the slot the patient chose.

person_id.description: The patient the reply is from. Must match the appointment's patient.

Reverted.description: The answer to cancelling a transfer.

Revoked.description: An authority that is now withdrawn.

RolloutRow.description: One clinic's stage: recording in shadow, or live, and whether it has been in shadow long enough to go live.

room.description: Where the patient is now; empty or absent clears it.

ScopeKind.description: What a tolerance applies to. `All` is the whole service; the others narrow it to one service or ward.

SeriesStatus.description:
Status of an appointment series. Individual occurrence statuses live
on the [`Appointment`] rows themselves.

SeriesWithOccurrences.description:
Result of [`SeriesService::get_with_occurrences`] and the cancel
endpoint. Shape mirrors `CreateSeriesResult`.

escalate_beyond.description: The drift past which it is red. Amber is between the two.

service.description: Set for one service only (the service type). Leave out both `service` and `ward` for the whole service.

tolerance.description: The drift (in the worse direction) that is still green.

ward.description: Set for one ward only (the ward code).

probability_percent.description: Present only once the weights are calibrated and `PAS_NOSHOW_SHOW_PERCENT=true`.

ShownAssessments.description: The stored no-show assessments for some appointments. `active` is false while the score is switched off.

forced_by.description: The first character that forced UCS-2, when it did.

units.description: Length in the encoding's own units (septets, or UTF-16 code units).

language.description: A locale code such as `cy-001`: the language the patient wants to be offered care in.

SupportKind.description: What kind of support a flag asks for.

TemplateGroup.description: The templates created together, one per language.

TemplateVariant.description: One language of a template group, with what its body would cost as a text.

by_service.description: The measures that can be read for one service, for each service that has data (or its own tolerance).

overall.description: The worst tier among every reading that has data; `no_data` when none do.

readings.description: Each measure for the whole service.

Transfer.description: A bed-to-bed move within a single admission.

template_name.description: The message being tested, for example `appointment_reminder_second`.

variants.description: Variant letter to template group name, for example `{"A": "appointment_reminder_second", "B": "second_b"}`.

reviewed_by.description: The person who reviewed the needs with the patient.

outcome.description: `approved` or `rejected`. A rejection switches the score off at once.

expires_at.description: For `extend`: the new end of the window.

external_ref.description: The sender's own reference, for example an e-RS UBRN. Required for `e-rs`.

redirect_to_service.description: For a redirect: the service the patient goes to.

triaged_by.description: The named person (a consultant or their delegate) who triaged it.

created_by.description: The administrator, when the request does not carry an identified caller.

endpoint.description: Where notifications are posted: `https`, or `http` on localhost.

secret_env.description: The name of the environment variable holding the signing secret, like `PAS_SUB_SECRET_PARTNER`.

assessed_at.description: When it was assigned; defaults to now, never in the future.

assessed_by.description: The person who assigned the category.

flowchart.description: The presentational flowchart used, as free text.

system_version.description: The edition or version of the system, for example "3.8".

counts.description: Items by state (`selected`, `asked`, ...), for the campaign page.

next.description: Why a person may act now, if they may: `letter_due`, `decision_due`.

age_in_use.description: Whether any age weight is in use (then the fairness approval must justify it).

percentage_shown.description: Whether the percentage is shown to staff (off until calibrated).

reason.description: Why it is off, in words, when it is.

info.description: Administrative (not clinical) API for appointments, waiting lists, reminders and replies, transport and virtual-visit requests, analytics and tolerances. Every REST response is an `ApiResponse` envelope. Identity and workforce are held by person-service and worker-service; /api/patients and /api/practitioners proxy them. Request bodies and query parameters of the REST routes are described (QUAL-34); typed responses are not yet.
